headline: News Corp Provides Update on $1 Billion Stock Repurchase Program
summary: News Corp provided an operational update regarding its ongoing $1 billion share buyback program.
why: Share repurchase programs reduce share counts, potentially boosting earnings per share and reflecting management's view that the stock is undervalued.

impacts.name: News Corp
impacts.why: News Corp is executing a capital return program via stock buybacks.
